scenes.name: captive-light
scenes.prompt: A single luminous golden songbird sits inside a tall black iron birdcage on an empty turquoise stone terrace. The bird glows from within like a tiny sun, with a long amber tail. The cage occupies the center-left, its sparse curved bars clearly surrounding the bird. Beyond the cage stretches a barren indigo valley with bare leafless trees. A small round red moon hangs above the distant horizon on the right. The cage has an arched door with a conspicuous golden latch. Warm light spills onto the cold terrace. The bird and bars are separated and readable. An exquisitely detailed surrealist oil painting, dream logic, luminous jewel-colored enamel against deep velvet shadows.
